scope: Milngin Ward supplementary by-election nominations and postal vote application deadlines.

sources.finding: NTEC’s 9 November notice confirms nominations are open and close at noon ACST on 20 November. Overseas postal vote applications close at 6 pm ACST on 29 November and local applications at 6 pm ACST on 1 December. The separate completed ballot receipt deadline remains noon ACST on 16 December.
Independent official timetable corroborates nominations, both application cutoffs and the voting dates.
Current elections directory lists Milngin Ward supplementary by-election and is dated 6 November 2026.
